author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Scott Pilgrim EX now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/scott-pilgrim-ex-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

When evil strikes Toronto, Scott Pilgrim, Ramona Flowers, and an unlikely team of allies must battle across the city to save the band... and the world. 

Fight through streets, alleys, beaches, and castles in this brand-new, standalone adventure in the Scott Pilgrim universe co-written by series creator Bryan Lee O’Malley. Gideon Graves is revealed as the final playable Evil Ex, bringing the roster to seven unique characters, each with their own distinct combat style. 

Level up your fighter, complete quests, discover secret areas, string together creative combos, and team up in local or online co-op in this action-packed beat ’em up from Tribute Games, featuring all-new music by Anamanaguchi. 

#NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #ScottPilgrimEX 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info
title: Scott Pilgrim EX – Out Now Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
